# dsh-aws-agent-toolkit

A community DeepSeek Harness
plugin bundle that brings the
Agent Toolkit for AWS to DSH —
the same t

wo-part setup AWS ships for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and Devin,
packaged as one installable DSH b

t setup AWS ships for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and Devin,
packaged as one installable DSH bundle:
| Row | What it adds |
| `aws-agent-toolkit-skills` | 25 AWS skills registered through `ctx.skills`. Catalog summaries are

cheap; bodies load on demand and `references/**` resolve against each skill directory. |
| `aws-agen
t-toolkit-mcp` | The managed **AWS MCP Server** (`https://aws-mcp.us-east-1.api.aws/mcp`) over the S
igV4 `uvx mcp-proxy-for-aws-cli` bridge, exposed as `mcp__aws__*` tools. |

Skills work with no AWS account. MCP tools connect once the standard AWS
credential chain has creden
tials (`aws login` or a configured profile).
## Requirements

- DeepSeek Harness with the plugin manager (Desktop or a profile-backed CLI).
- **Node.js 20+** on `

PATH` — the MCP row runs
`lib/aws-mcp-bridge.mjs`.
- **`uvx`** from uv on `PATH` — runs the
`mcp-pro

xy-for-aws-cli` package on demand.
- **AWS credentials** for the MCP tools — `aws login` (AWS CLI 2.

39+) or
`aws configure`. Skills alone need none.

Switching an existing profile from a local `link:` install to the GitHub spec

mport. Remove the bundle first

## Why the bridge

The managed AWS server names its tools `aws___<tool>`, while DSH names every
MCP tool `mcp__<serverN

ame>__<rawName>`. With `serverName: aws` the prefixes
stack into `mcp__aws__aws___search_documentati

on`. DSH's MCP client has no
per-tool rename option, so `lib/aws-mcp-bridge.mjs` is
a transparent st

dio relay: it strips `aws___` from `tools/list` results and
re-adds it on `tools/call`. Initializati

on, instructions, resources, pagination,
progress, and errors pass through untouched.
## How it works

- `lib/index.js` is a Host plugin (`inject: ['skills']`). On activation it scans
`skills/`, parses e

ach `SKILL.md` frontmatter once, and registers one provider.
`list()` returns summaries; `get()` re-

reads the current body and returns it
with a `directory` resource base, so edits show up on the next

load.
- `cordis.patch.yml` inserts that plugin and one `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client`
row. The MCP r

ow launches `node <profile>/node_modules/<bundle>/lib/aws-mcp-bridge.mjs`
with the proxy arguments;
the bridge starts `uvx mcp-proxy-for-aws-cli@latest`.
